def diff(snap):
    b = snap.split('\n'); c = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
    return [(r,cc,b[r][cc],c[r][cc]) for r in range(64) for cc in range(64) if b[r][cc]!=c[r][cc]]
def gpos():
    L = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
    p=[(r,c) for r in range(36,45) for c in range(6,16) if L[r][c]=='N']
    return (min(r for r,c in p), min(c for r,c in p))
path = ['LEFT','LEFT','DOWN','DOWN','RIGHT','RIGHT','UP','LEFT']
for a in path:
    s = current_frame.ascii
    action([a])
    d = [x for x in diff(s) if x[0]!=63]
    print(a, "gpos", gpos(), "extra:", d if d else "none", "reward", last_action_result.get('reward'), "lc", last_action_result.get('level_completed'))
    if last_action_result.get('level_completed') or last_action_result.get('done') or last_action_result.get('game_over'):
        print("STOP"); break
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
